notes: Every source and target id is partitioned once; 17 source ids and 23 target ids all accounted for.

The two *it*s are `added`: neither imperative carries an object morpheme, and they are two units rather than one because the ASV's own rendered material (*rase*) stands between them, as rule 2 directs.
*Even to* is the limit preposition's whole rendering under rule 16, headed on the relational word; no conjunction morpheme stands beside עַד, so the *even* is not a waw's.
בָּהּ is one two-morpheme unit rendered *thereof* under rule 22, headed on the preposition since no relative stands in it.
